id: 15_Replace the AC Contactor for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊机：更换交流接触器
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/15_Replace the AC Contactor for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/15_Replace the AC Contactor for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K18: 扳手卡螺母，拆固定螺钉
points.K23: 组件放回，六颗螺钉固定

shots.scene: 欣欣站在侧门打开的激光焊接机旁，指着机内一个方块形的黑色元件，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with its side open, points at a black block-shaped electrical component inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的交流接触器怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊机：更换交流接触器

shots.scene: 四个图标：警示卡、安装板、接触器、扎带
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a warning card, a mounting plate, a black contactor and a cable tie. No people.
shots.narration: 取组件、换接触器、接线、装回。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着焊机，屏幕显示故障图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the laser welding machine, whose screen shows a fault icon.
shots.narration: 焊机的交流接触器需要更换了。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和新接触器走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over carrying a toolbox and a new blank black contactor.
shots.narration: 专业技术人员老李来更换。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看具体步骤。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换接触器只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能残留高压，至少等5分钟再碰。

shots.scene: 警示卡上一副绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with a yellow and black striped border showing an insulated glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、开口扳手、内六角扳手、扎带、剪刀和新接触器
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, an open-end wrench, a hex key, cable ties, scissors and a new blank black contactor. No people.
shots.narration: 5、3毫米十字刀，7毫米扳手，3毫米内六角。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty and the unplugged cables coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 静置10分钟，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the machine.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板。

shots.scene: 老李拆送丝安装板周边螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder mounting plate.
shots.narration: 拆下安装板十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screw of the yellow-green earth wire.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线螺钉。

shots.scene: 安装板放平，露出机内一排黑色接触器和一个黄色模块
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate is laid outward, revealing a row of black contactors and a yellow module inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 放平安装板。

shots.scene: 剪刀剪断两根扎带
shots.prompt_en: Scissors snip two cable ties holding the wire bundle near the contactors.
shots.narration: 剪断两根扎带。

shots.scene: 十字刀拧下接触器顶部端子，四根线取下
shots.prompt_en: A cross-head screwdriver loosens the top terminals of the contactor and four wires are removed.
shots.narration: 用5毫米十字刀拆顶部4根线。

shots.scene: 画面一角标出六颗螺钉位置，老李逐颗拧下
shots.prompt_en: A small inset marks six screw positions with arrows while the facility engineer removes them one by one.
shots.narration: 拆下固定组件的六颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 接触器和黄色模块所在的整块安装板被取出
shots.prompt_en: The whole mounting plate carrying the black contactors and the yellow module is lifted out of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 把整块组件取下来，放到工作台。

shots.scene: 工作台上，老李拆下接触器上的线
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench, the facility engineer disconnects the wires from the contactor terminals.
shots.narration: 在台面上拆下接触器的八根线。

shots.section_title: 扳手卡螺母，拆固定螺钉
shots.scene: 组件背面，开口扳手卡住螺母，内六角扳手拧螺钉
shots.prompt_en: On the back of the plate, an open-end wrench holds a nut while a hex key turns the fixing screw.
shots.narration: 扳手卡住螺母，3毫米内六角拧螺钉。
overlay: 扳手卡螺母，拆固定螺钉

shots.section_title: 扳手卡螺母，拆固定螺钉
shots.scene: 两颗螺钉逐颗拆下
shots.prompt_en: The two fixing screws are removed one at a time.
shots.narration: 两颗螺钉，一颗一颗拆。

shots.scene: 接触器沿导轨滑出
shots.prompt_en: The old contactor slides off the metal mounting rail.
shots.narration: 把旧接触器从导轨上滑出来。

shots.scene: 新接触器滑上导轨
shots.prompt_en: The new contactor slides onto the mounting rail.
shots.narration: 新接触器滑上导轨。

shots.scene: 扳手和内六角配合，拧紧两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The wrench and hex key work together to tighten the two fixing screws.
shots.narration: 拧紧两颗螺钉固定。

shots.scene: 画面一角是参考图，老李把八根线接回接触器
shots.prompt_en: A small reference picture in the corner while the facility engineer reconnects eight wires to the contactor.
shots.narration: 对照参考图，接回八根线。

shots.scene: 老李逐根轻拉导线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently tugs each wire one by one.
shots.narration: 每根线轻轻一拉，确认接牢。

shots.section_title: 组件放回，六颗螺钉固定
shots.scene: 组件放回机柜，六颗螺钉拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate assembly is placed back into the cabinet and six screws are tightened.
shots.narration: 组件放回机柜，六颗螺钉固定。
overlay: 组件放回，六颗螺钉固定

shots.scene: 顶部端子用绿框标出，四根线接回
shots.prompt_en: The top terminals of the contactor are highlighted with a green frame and four wires are reconnected.
shots.narration: 接回顶部四根线。

shots.scene: 参考图与实物线序用虚线对应
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank reference wiring picture and the four wires on top of the contactor, joined by matching dotted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序必须和参考图完全一致。

shots.scene: 线缆用扎带重新捆好，剪掉多余尾巴
shots.prompt_en: The wires are bundled again with cable ties and the extra tails are trimmed.
shots.narration: 用扎带重新捆好线缆。

shots.scene: 老李抬回安装板，接送丝电机线和接地线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back and reconnects the wire feeder motor cable and earth wire.
shots.narration: 接回电机线和接地线。

shots.scene: 左门板关上，外侧板装回
shots.prompt_en: The left side door is closed and the outer side cover is refitted.
shots.narration: 关好门板，装回外侧板。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a warning card, an hourglass, a wrench and a contactor.
shots.narration: 专业人员操作，断电静置，取下组件。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 轻拉查牢固，线序对参考图。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 接触器换好了，下次见！
